English: The study of disease organisms as invasive alien species has not received a great deal of attention in the field of invasion science.

Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo ka ga diphedinyana tšeo di bakago malwetši bjalo ka mehuta ya diphedinyana tša go šwahlela tšeo di sego tša lefelo leo di hweditše šedi ye kgolo ka lekaleng la dithutamahlae tša mabapi le go šwahlela.

English: Introduced pathogens can have profound effects on living organisms, the ecosystems that they inhabit, and the economies that the ecosystems support.
Luganda: Ebireeta endwadde ebireete bisobola okukoseza ddala ebiramu, ebifo mwe bibeera, ate n’ebyenfuna ebifo ebyo bye biwanirira.
Yoruba: Àwọn afàìsàn pátójíìni tí a fi hànde le è ní ipa tí ó lóòrìn lórí àwọn ọgánísíìmù tí ń mí, ibùgbé àwọn ẹrànko, irúgbìn àti àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí mìíràn àti ìmọ ọrọ̀ ajé èyí tí ibùgbé àwọn ẹrànko, irúgbìn àti àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí mìíràn fi ara mọ́.
Zulu: Amagciwane angenisiwe angaba nethonya elinamandla ezintweni eziphilayo, izimiso zemvelo ezihlala kuzo, kanye nezomnotho ezisekelwa imvelo.
Hausa: Ƙwayoyin cuta da aka ɓullo da su suna iya yin tasiri mai tsanani a kan rayayyun halittu, da halittun da suke zaune, da kuma tattalin arzikin da halittun suke tallafawa.
Northern Sotho: Dibakamalwetši tšeo di tlišitšwego di ka ba le diabe tše kgolo go diphedi, go phedišano ya diphedi yeo di dulago go yona, le diekonomi tšeo di thekgwago ke phadišano yeo ya diphedi.
Amharic: በሽታ አምጪ ተህዋሲያን በህያዋን ፍጥረታት ላይ፣ በሚኖሩባቸው ስነ-ምህዳሮች እና ስነ-ምህዳሩን በሚደግፉት ኢኮኖሚዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ሊያሳድሩ ይችላሉ።

English: In this chapter, we use case studies of introduced diseases of domestic and wild animals (canine rabies, bovine tuberculosis, and rinderpest) and humans (smallpox, measles and human immunodeficiency virus, HIV) to illustrate the kinds of effects that these pathogens can have.
Luganda: Mu ssuula eno, tukozesa okunoonyereza okukwata ku ndwadde ezireetebwa mu nsolo z’awaka n’ez’omu nsiko (canine rabies, akafuba mu nte, ne nsotoka) ne mu bantu (kawaali, olukusense ne Mukenenya, HIV) ng’ebyokulabirako okulaga okukosa ebireeta endwadde kye bisobola okukola.
Yoruba: Nínú orí yìí, a ṣe àmúlò kéèsì àwọn àrùn ara àwọn ẹranko ilé àti ti inú igbó tí a fi hànde (àrùn àramọ́ ara ajá -rébíìsì, ikọ́ ẹran, àti àjàkálẹ̀ ọ̀sìn ẹran) àti ọmọ-ènìyàn (ilẹ̀ gbóónà/olóde, ẹ̀yi, àti àwọn fáírọ́ọ̀sì ìsọdọ̀lẹ̀-àjẹsára ọmọ ènìyàn, HIV) láti ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ àwọn irúfẹ́ ipa tí àwọn afàìsàn pátójíìnì le è ní.
Zulu: Kulesi sahluko, sisebenzisa izifundo zezifo ezethulwe zezilwane ezifuywayo nezasendle (i-canine rabies, isifo sofuba sezinkomo, kanye ne-rinderpest) kanye nabantu (i-smallpox, isimungumungwane kanye negciwane lesandulela ngculazi, i-HIV) ukuze sibonise izinhlobo zemiphumela lezi zifo ezingaba nazo.
Hausa: A wannan babi, mun yi amfani da nazarin binciken da aka gabatar na cututtukan gida da na daji (cutar haukar kare da tarin fuka na shanu ɗa ɓaunaye, da kuma gudawar shanu) da kuma na mutane (ƙwayar cutar agana da ƙyanda da kuma cuta mai karya garkuwar jikin ɗan’adam, HIV) dominn kwatanta nau’o’i illolin da waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta za su iya samu.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo kgaolong ye, re šomiša dinyakišišo ka ga malwetši ao a tlišitšwego a diphoofolo tša go ruiwa le diphoofolo tša nageng (bogaswi bja dimpša, TB ya dikgomo, le rinderpest) le a batho (sepšhatlapšhatlane, mooko le baerase ya go palediša mašole a mmele go šoma, HIV) go laetša mehuta ya diabe tšeo dibakamalwetši a di ka bago le ona.
Amharic: በዚህ ምእራፍ ውስጥ፣ እነዚህ በሽታ አምጪ ተህዋሲያን ሊያደርሱ የሚችሉትን አይነት ተፅእኖ ለማሳየት በቤት ውስጥ እና በዱር እንስሳት (የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ፣ የዳልጋ ከብት ሳንባ ነቀርሳ፣ እና የደስታ በሽታ) እና በሰዎች (ፈንጣጣ፣ ኩፍኝ እና የሰውን በሽታ የመከላከል አቅምን የሚያዳክም ቫይረስ፣ ኤችአይቪ) የተዋወቁ የኬዝ ጥናቶችን እንጠቀማለን።

English: The most dramatic impact to date was that of rinderpest, which caused the death of millions of cattle, and practically annihilated certain forms of wildlife from large parts of southern Africa.
Luganda: Okukosebwa okukyasinze okubera okw’amaanyi n’okutuusa leero kye kirwadde kya nsotoka ekyaviirako ente bukadde na bukadde okufa ate ne kizikiriza ebika by’ebisolo ebimu mu bitundu by’obukiikaddyo bwa Afirika.
Yoruba: Ipa tí ó rinlẹ̀ jùlọ títí di òní ni ti àjàkálẹ̀ ọ̀sìn ẹran, èyí tí ó máa ń ṣe ikú pa ogúnlọ́gọ̀ agbo màlúù, àti pẹ̀lú a máa fa ìparun irúfẹ́ àwọn ẹranko ìgbẹ́ kan ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìdá agbègbè gúsù Africa.
Zulu: Umthelela omkhulu kunayo yonke kuze kube manje kwaba yi-rinderpest, eyabulala izigidi zezinkomo, futhi yaqothula izinhlobo ezithile zezilwane zasendle ezingxenyeni ezinkulu ze-Afrika eseningizimu.
Hausa: Babban tasirin da ya fi ɗaukar hankali a yau shi ne na gudawar shanu, wanda ya yi sanadiyyar mutuwar miliyoyin shanu, kuma a zahiri ya halaka wasu nau’o’in namun daji daga manyan sassan kudancin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Seabe se sešoro kudu go fihla mo lebakeng le e bile sa bolwetši bja rinderpest, bjo bo ka bakago mahu a dikgomo tše milione, le go bolawa mehuta ye mengwe ya diphoofolo tša naga ka dikarolong tše kgolo tša borwa bja Afrika.
Amharic: እስካሁን ድረስ በጣም አስገራሚው ተፅዕኖ፣ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ከብቶች እንዲሞቱ ያደረጋቸው፣ እና የተወሰኑ የዱር አራዊትን ከደቡባዊ አፍሪካ ትላልቅ ክፍሎች ያጠፋው የደስታ በሽታ ነው።

English: This in turn impacted severely on the region’s economy, and resulted in large-scale changes to the structure and dynamics of ecosystems.
Luganda: Ekyava mu kino era kwe kukosa obubi ennyo ebyenfuna by’ekitundu ekyo, era ne muvaamu n’enkyukakyuka za maanyi mu nfaanana n’entereeza y’obutonde bw’ensi.
Yoruba: Abájáde èyí ni pé, ó kó ipa ribiribi lórí ètò ọrọ̀ ajé agbègbè náà, àti pé ó ti mú àyípadà tí ó lágbára bá ìlànà àti ìmúdàgbà ibùgbé àwọn ẹrànko, irúgbìn àti àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí mìíràn.
Zulu: Lokhu kube nomthelela omubi emnothweni wesifunda, futhi kwaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu ekwakhekeni nasekuguquguqukeni kwezinhlelo zemvelo.
Hausa: Wannan kuma ya yi tasiri mai tsanani ga tattalin arzikin yankin, kuma ya haifar da sauye-sauye masu yawa ga tsari da yanaye-yanayen muhalli.
Northern Sotho: Se ka moragonyana se ile sa ama kudu ekonomi ya ka mo seleteng se, gomme sa feletša ka diphetogo tše kgolo go sebopego le diphetogo tša phadišano ya diphedi.
Amharic: ይህ ደግሞ በክልሉ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ አሳድሯል፣ እናም በስነ-ምህዳሮች ተለዋዋጭነት እና አወቃቀር ላይ መጠነ-ሰፊ ለውጦችን አድርጓል።

English: Rinderpest has been eradicated globally, but both canine rabies and bovine tuberculosis remain, and ongoing vigilance and management will be required to contain them.
Luganda: Nsotoka alwanyisiddwa wonna mu nsi, naye ate canine rabies ne bovine tuberculosis bwo bukyaliwo, era kaweefube ow’amaanyi atatadde ajja kwetaagisa okubulwanyisa.
Yoruba: Àjàkálẹ̀ ọ̀sìn ẹran ti di ohun ìparun káàkiri gbogbo àgbáyé, ṣùgbọ́n àrùn àramọ́ ara ajá -rébíìsì, àti ikọ́ ẹran bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ìsṣọ́rà àti ìṣàkóso yóò nílò láti fi àyè gbà wọ́n.
Zulu: I-Rinderpest isiqediwe emhlabeni wonke, kodwa kokubili amarabi e-canine nesifo sofuba sezinkomo kusekhona, futhi ukuqapha okuqhubekayo nokuphathwa kuyodingeka ukuze kuqukethwe.
Hausa: An kawar da cutar Gudawar Shanu a duk duniya, amma duka cutar haukar kare da tarin fuka na shanu da ɓaunaye sun kasance, kuma ana buƙatar ci gaba da sa-ido da kulawa don kawar da su.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bja rinderpest bo fedišitšwe lefaseng ka bophara, eupša bobedi bogaswi bja dimpša le TB ya dikgomo di sa le gona, le gomme go tšwela pele go ntšha mahlo dinameng le go a laola go tla nyakega gore a laolwe.
Amharic: የደስታ በሽታ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተወግዷል፣ ነገር ግን ሁለቱም የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ እና የዳልጋ ከብት ሳንባ ነቀርሳ ይቀራሉ፣ እና እነሱን ለመያዝ ቀጣይነት ያለው ጥንቃቄ እና አስተዳደር ያስፈልጋል።

English: Of the human diseases, smallpox has also been eradicated globally, but the effect of the disease, introduced by European colonists, was devastating.
Luganda: Mu ndwadde ezitawaanya abantu, kawaali naye aweddewo mu nsi yonna naye okukosa kw’obulwadde obwo, obwaleetebwa abafuzi b’amatwale Bannabulaaya, kwo kwali kwamaanyi ddala.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn àìsàn ọmọ ènìyàn, ilẹ̀ gbóónà olóde náà ti di pihparẹ́ jákèjádò àgbáyé, ṣùgbọ́n ipa àìsàn náà, èyí tí àwọn amúnisìn Yúróòpù kó wá burú jáì.
Zulu: Ezifweni zabantu, ingxibongo isiqediwe emhlabeni wonke, kodwa umphumela walesi sifo, owethulwa amakoloni aseYurophu, wawubuhlungu kakhulu.
Hausa: Daga cikin cututtukan mutane, an kuma kawar da cutar agana a duniya, amma tasirin cutar da Turawan Mulkin Mallaka suka ɓullo da ita ta yi muni sosai.
Northern Sotho: Go malwetši a batho, sepšhatlapšhatlane le sona se fedišitšwe lefaseng ka bophara, eupša seabe sa bolwetši bjo, seo se tlišitšwego ke bakoloniale ba ka Yuropa, se be se le šoro.
Amharic: ከሰው በሽታዎች መካከል፣ ፈንጣጣ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተወግዷል፣ በአውሮፓ ቅኝ ገዥዎች የተዋወቀው፣ የበሽታው ጥፋት፣ ግን አስከፊ ነበር።

English: In the early 1700s, a large proportion (up to 90% in some communities) of the indigenous Khoekhoe people died, destroying their culture and way of life, and leaving the few survivors to be recruited as farm labourers.
Luganda: Mu myaka gya 1700, ettundutundu ly’abatu (mu bitundu ebimu kumpi kutuuka ku 90%) eby’abantu Ba-Khoekhoe bannansangwa baafa, obuwangwa bwabwe n’embeera zaabwe zonna ne bisaanawo era abo abatono abaasigalawo ne batandika kukola bupakasi mu malimiro.
Yoruba: Ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún 1700, ìdá púpọ̀ ( èyí tí ó tó 90% ní àwọn agbègbè kọ̀ọ̀kan) nínú àwọn ọmọ ìbílẹ̀ Khoekhoe ni ó kú, ó ba àṣà àti ìlànà ìgbé ayé wọn jẹ́, tí ó sì sọ àwọn ìwọ̀nba pérétè tí ó yè é di alágbàro nínú oko.
Zulu: Ekuqaleni kwawo-1700, ingxenye enkulu (kufika ku-90% kweminye imiphakathi) yabantu bomdabu baseKhoekhoe bafa, becekela phansi isiko labo kanye nendlela yabo yokuphila, futhi kwashiya abambalwa abasindile ukuba babuthwe njengabasebenzi basemapulazini.
Hausa: A farkon shekarun 1700, wani adadi mai yawa (har zuwa kashi 90% a wasu al’ummomi) na ‘yan asalin Khoekhoe sun mutu, sun lalata al’adunsu da tsarin rayuwarsu, kuma sun bar ’yan tsirarun da suka tsira domin a ɗauki su a matsayin ma’aikatan gona.
Northern Sotho: Mathomong a mengwaga ya bo 1700, ditšhaba tše ntši (go fihla ka 90% ka ditšhabeng tše dingwe) tša batho ba mathomong ba Makhoikhoi ba ile ba hlokofala, ba senya setšo sa bona le mokgwa wa bona wa go phela, gomme se sa tlogela ba mmalwa ba bona bao ba phologilego go thwalwa bjalo ka bašomi ba ka dipolaseng.
Amharic: በ1700ዎቹ መጀመሪያ ላይ፣ ብዙ ቁጥር ያለው (በአንዳንድ ማህበረሰቦች ውስጥ እስከ 90% የሚደርሰው) የኮሆክሆይ ተወላጆች ሞተዋል፣ ባህላቸውን እና አኗኗራቸውን አውድመው፣ እና ጥቂት የተረፉትን በእርሻ ሰራተኛነት እንዲቀጠሩ ተደረገ።

English: HIV, first detected in South Africa in 1982 has also had substantial impacts and antiretroviral treatment alone currently costs the government ZAR 66.4 billion annually.
Luganda: HIV, yasooka okukengebwa mu South Afirika mu 1982, era naye akosezza nnyo ekitundu ekyo, ate eddagala erimukkakkanya lyokka gavumenti erisaasaanyizaako obuwumbi bwa ZAR 66.4 buli mwaka.
Yoruba: Fáírọ́ọ̀sì ìsọdọ̀lẹ-àjẹsára ọmọ ènìyàn HIV, èyí tí wọ́n kọ́kọ́ ní ìmọ̀ nípa rẹ̀ ní orílẹ̀ èdè South Africa ní ọdún 1982 náà tí ní ipa tí ó rinlẹ̀ àti àwọn ìtọ́jú ìgbógunti ìranmọ́ni àrùn nìkan lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ ná ìjọba tó bílíọ́nù ZAR 66.4 ní ọdún kan.
Zulu: I-HIV, eyatholwa okokuqala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982 nayo ibe nomthelela omkhulu futhi ukwelashwa ngezidambisigciwane kukodwa okwamanje kubiza uhulumeni i-ZAR 66.4 billion njalo ngonyaka.
Hausa: Cutar HIV, wanda aka fara gano ta a Afirka ta Kudu a cikin shekarar 1982 ta kuma yi mummunan tasiri mai yawa kuma magungunan ƙanjamau kansu kaɗai a halin yanzu suna ci wa gwamnati ZAR biliyan 66.4 a kowace shekara.
Northern Sotho: HIV, yeo e utollotšwego la mathomo ka Afrika Borwa ka 1982 le yona e bile le diabe tše kgolo gomme mo lebakeng le kalafo ka dianthiretherobaerale e nnoši di bitša mmušo tšhelete ye e ka bago ZAR 66.4 pilione ka ngwaga.
Amharic: ኤችአይቪ፣ መጀመሪያ በ1982 ደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ነው የተገኘው በተጨማሪም ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ያሳደረ ሲሆን በአሁን ጊዜ የፀረ-ኤችአይቪ ሕክምና ብቻውን መንግሥትን 66.4 ቢሊዮን ZAR (የደቡብ አፍሪካ ራንድ) በየዓመቱ ያስወጣዋል።

English: We also include West Nile Virus and African Swine Fever as examples of diseases that originated in Africa, and that may yet become globally destructive.
Luganda: Era tutunuulira ne West Nile Virus wamu n’Omusujja gw’Embizzi ng’ebyokulabirako by’endwadde ezaasibuka mu Afirika, era ziyinza okutaataaganya ensi yonna.
Yoruba: Bákan náà ni a tún ṣe àfikún fáírọ́sì West Nile àti àrun ibá ẹlédẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí àpẹẹrẹ àwọn àrùn tí wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní Africa, àti àwọn tí ó ṣe é ṣe kí wọ́n di àrùn tí ó lè ba gbogbo ayé jẹ́.
Zulu: Siphinde sihlanganise i-West Nile Virus kanye ne-African Swine Fever njengezibonelo zezifo ezaqala e-Afrika, futhi ezingase zibe yingozi emhlabeni wonke.
Hausa: Har wa yau, mun haɗa da Ƙwayar Cutar ta Nilu ta Yamma da Zazzaɓin Alade na Afirka a matsayin misalan cututtuka da suka samo asali a Afirka, kuma waɗanda har yanzu suna iya zama masu ɓarna a duniya.
Northern Sotho: Re akaretša gape Baerase ya West Nile le Bolwetši bja Dikolobe bja Afrika bjalo ka mehlala ya malwetši ao a thomilego ka Afrika, ao a sego a hlwa a eba le tshenyo lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: እንዲሁም የዌስት ናይል ቫይረስን እና የአፍሪካን የአሳማ ትኩሳትን ከአፍሪካ እንደመጡ፣ እና ገና አለም አቀፍ አጥፊ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ በሽታዎችን እንደ ምሳሌ እናቀርባለን።

English: We predict that new diseases will emerge as humans continue to expand their range into wild areas, and as trade volumes increase.
Luganda: Tuteebereza nti endwadde empya zijja kujja era ng’abantu bwe bagenda balumba ensiko okusengamu, ate era nga n’obusuubuzi bwe bugenda bweyongera.
Yoruba: Asọ tẹ́lẹ̀ pé àwọn àìsàn tuntun máa yọjú bí àwọn ọmọ ènìyàn bá ṣe ń fẹ kíkopa wọn nínú ìgbẹ́ lójú, àti bí kátàkárà bá ṣe ń tẹ̀síwájú.
Zulu: Sibikezela ukuthi izifo ezintsha zizovela njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokwandisa ububanzi bazo ezindaweni zasendle, futhi njengoba amanani ohwebo akhula.
Hausa: Mun yi hasashen cewa sababbin cututtuka za su ɓulla a syayin da mutane suke ci gaba da faɗaɗa kewayonsu zuwa yankunan daji, kuma a yayin da adadin ciniki ya ƙaru.
Northern Sotho: Re akanya gore malwetši a maswa a tla tšwelela ge batho ba tšwela pele go tsena ka mafelong a dithokgweng, le ge bogolo bja dikgwebišano bo oketšega.
Amharic: ሰዎች ወደ ዱር አከባቢዎች መስፋፋታቸውን ሲቀጥሉ፣ እና የንግድ ልውውጦች እየጨመሩ በሄዱ ቁጥር አዳዲስ በሽታዎች ብቅ ሊሉ እንደሚችሉ እንገምታለን።

English: This book chapter summarises the latest information on diseases such as rinderpest, rabies, measles and HIV, all caused by invasive microorganisms (viruses, bacteria and other small creatures that are considered a non-native species, meaning that they are not naturally found in a particular environment).
Luganda: Essuula y’ekitabo eno efunza obubaka obwakasembayo okufunika ku ndwadde gamba nga nsotoka, obulwadde bw’embwa, olukusense ne HIV, zonna zireetebwa obuwuka obusenguse (obuwuka, bakitiiriya n’ebitonde ebirala ebitono ebitwalibwa okuba nga si binnansangwa, ekitegeeza nti mu butonde bwabyo tebisangibwa mu kitundu ekimu).
Yoruba: Orí yìí ṣe àkópọ̀ àwọn ìmọ̀ tí ó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ jáde gbogbo lórí àwọn àìsàn bíi àjàkálẹ̀ ọ̀sìn ẹran, àrùn àramọ́ ara ajá -rébíìsì, ẹ̀yi àti fáírọ́ọ̀sì ìsọdọ̀lẹ-àjẹsára ọmọ ènìyàn HIV, gbogbo èyí ni àwọn àjòjì ọgánísíìmù ń sokùfà (fáírọ́ọ̀sì, bakitéríà àti àwọn ẹ̀dá kékèké tí wọ́n dúró gẹ́gẹ́ bí àkójọ ọ̀wọ́ àjèjì sí agbègbè kan, èyí túnmọ̀ sí pé wọn kìí dédé rí wọn ní àwọn agbègbè kan ní pàtó).
Zulu: Lesi sahluko sifingqa imininingwane yakamuva ngezifo ezifana ne-rinderpest, amarabi, isimungumungwane kanye ne-HIV, zonke ezibangelwa amagciwane ahlaselayo (amagciwane, amagciwane nezinye izidalwa ezincane ezithathwa njengezilwane okungezona ezomdabu, okusho ukuthi azitholakali ngokwemvelo emzimbeni indawo ethile).
Hausa: Wannan babi na littafin yana taƙaita sababbin bayanai ne a kan cututtuka irin su gudawar shanu da cutar hauka da ƙyanda da kuma HIV, duk waɗanda ƙananan halittu masu mamaya suke haifarwa (ƙwayoyin cuta da bakteriya da kuma sauran ƙananan halittu waɗanda ake kallon su a matsayin nau’in da ba na asali ba ne, ma'ana bisa al’ada ba a samun su a wani muhalli na musamman).
Northern Sotho: Kgaolo ye ya puku e fa kakaretšo ka ga Tshedimošo ya moragorago ka ga malwetši a go swana le rinderpest, bogaswi bja dimpša, mooko le HIV, ka moka ga ona a bakwa ke diphedinyana tša go šwahlela (dibaerase, dipkatheria le diphedinyana tše dingwe tše nnyane tšeo di bonwago bjalo ka mehuta yeo e sego ya lefelo leo, go era gore ga di hwetšwe tikologong ye itšego ka tlhago).
Amharic: ይህ የመፅሃፍ ምእራፍ እንደ የደስታ በሽታ፣ የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ፣ ኩፍኝ እና ኤችአይቪ፣ በመሳሰሉት በሽታዎች፣ ሁሉም በወራሪ ረቂቅ ተሕዋስያን (ቫይረሶች፣ ባክቴሪያ እና ሀገር በቀል ያልሆኑ ዝርያዎች ተደርገው በሚወሰዱ ሌሎች ትንንሽ ፍጥረታት፣ ይህም ማለት በተፈጥሮ በአንድ የተለየ አካባቢ ውስጥ አይገኙም ማለት ነው) ላይ ወቅታዊ መረጃን ያጠቃልላል።

English: These diseases all affect animals and people in South Africa, and outbreaks ultimately hurt the country’s economy.
Luganda: Endwadde ezo zonna zikosa ensolo n’abantu mu South Afirika, era bwe zibalukawo zikoseza ddala ebyenfuna by’eggwanga.
Yoruba: Gbogbo àwọn àrùn wọ̀nyí ni wọ́n máa ń ní ipa lórí àwọn ẹranko àti àwọn ènìyàn ní South Africa, ìbújadé àrùn a sì máa ṣe ọrọ̀ ajé orílẹ̀ èdè náà ní jàǹbá púpọ̀.
Zulu: Lezi zifo zonke zithinta izilwane nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukuqubuka kwezifo kugcina kulimaza umnotho wezwe.
Hausa: Waɗannan cututtuka duk sun shafi dabbobi da mutane a Afirka ta Kudu, kuma ɓarkewar cututtukan a ƙarshe ya yi illa ga tattalin arzikin ƙasar.
Northern Sotho: Malwetši a ka moka a ama diphoofolo le batho ka Afrika Borwa, gomme go phulega ga malwetši mafelelong go kweša ekonomi ya ka mo nageng bohloko.
Amharic: እነዚህ በሽታዎች በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ በእንስሳትና በሰዎች ላይ ተፅዕኖ ያሳድራሉ፣ እና ወረርሽኞች በመጨረሻ የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚ ይጎዳሉ።

English: In a field of research called ‘invasive science’, scientists study organisms that thrive and cause harm after being introduced into new environments where they are not normally found.
Luganda: Mu kisaawe ky’okunoonyereza ekiyitibwa ‘ssaayansi w’ebisenguse’, bannassaayansi banoonyereza ku bitonde ebibeera awantu era ne bireeta endwadde nga bitwaliddwa mu kitundu ekipya gye bitatera kusangibwa.
Yoruba: Nínú ẹ̀ka ìsèwádìí tí a ń pè ní ‘sáyẹńsì àfòmọ́’ àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì ṣe ìwádìí àwọn ọ́gánísíìmù tí wọ́n máa ń fa ìpalára lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n bá ti yọjú sí agbègbè tuntun, níbi tí wọ́n kò sí tẹ́lẹ̀.
Zulu: Emkhakheni wocwaningo obizwa ngokuthi ‘isayensi ehlaselayo’, ososayensi bacwaninga ngezinto eziphilayo ezichumayo nezidala umonakalo ngemva kokwethulwa ezindaweni ezintsha lapho zingatholakali khona ngokuvamile.
Hausa: A wani fanni na bincike da ake kira ‘kimiyar mamaya’, masana kimiyya suna nazarin ƙwayoyin halittar da suke bunƙasa da kuma cutarwa bayan an shigar da su cikin sababbin mahallai da ba a saba samun su ba.
Northern Sotho: Ka lekaleng la dinyakišišo tšeo di bitšwago ‘dithutamahlale ka go šwahlela’, bašomi ba tša mahlale ba nyakišiša ka ga diphedinyana tšeo di phelago le go baka malwetši ka morago ga ge di tlišitšwe tikologong ye mpsha fao ka tlwaelo di sa hwetšagalego gona.
Amharic: ‘ወራሪ ሳይንስ’ በሚባለው የምርምር ዘርፍ፣ ሳይንቲስቶች በተለምዶ ወደማይገኙባቸው አዳዲስ አካባቢዎች ከገቡ በኋላ የሚበለጽጉ እና ጉዳት የሚያደርሱ ፍጥረታትን ያጠናል።

English: Most research has focussed on large “invasive species” like plants and animals, but microscopic invaders that cause disease are as important.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okusinga kutunuulira nnyo “endyo ensenguse” ennene gamba ng’ebimera n’ebisolo, naye n’obuwuka obusirikitu obusenguse obuleeta endwadde nabwo bukulu okufaako.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ni ó ti gbájú mọ́ ọ̀pọ̀ “ọ̀wọ́ ọ̀tọ̀ àwọn àjòjì ọgánísíìmù” bíi àwọn ewéko àti ẹranko, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọ̀wọ́ ọ̀tọ̀ akógunja a-fi-máíkósópù-wò tí wọ́n ń fa àìsàn náà ṣe pàtàkì.
Zulu: Ucwaningo oluningi lugxile “ezinhlotsheni zezilwane ezihlaselayo” ezinkulu njengezitshalo nezilwane, kodwa abahlaseli abancane abangebona izifo babaluleke kakhulu.
Hausa: Yawancin bincike sun mayar da hankali ne a kan manyan "jinsuna masu mamayewa" kamar tsirrai da kuma dabbobi, amma ƙananan halittu masu mamayewa da suke haifar da cututtuka suna da mahimmanci.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja dinyakišišo di lebeletše kudu “mehuta ya diphedi tša go šwahlela” tše kgolo tša go swana le tša dimeleng le diphoofolo, eupša diphedinyana tša go bonwa ka maekherosekoupu tše di bakago malwetši le tšona di bohlokwa.
Amharic: አብዛኛው ምርምር ያተኮረው እንደ ተክሎች እና እንስሳት ባሉ ትላልቅ "ወራሪ ዝርያዎች" ላይ ነው፣ ነገር ግን በሽታን የሚያስከትሉ በአይን የማይታዩ ጥቃቅን ወራሪዎች በጣም አስፈላጊ ናቸው።

English: In this chapter, the authors discussed some animal and human diseases in South Africa that are caused by those introduced microorganisms.
Luganda: Mu ssuula eno, abawandiisi bakubaganya ebirowoozo ku ndwadde z’ensolo ezimu n’endwadde z’abantu mu South Afirika ezireetebwa obuwuka obwo obusirikitu.
Yoruba: Nínú orí yìí, àwọn òǹkọ̀wé ṣe àlàyé àwọn àìsàn ẹranko àti ti ènìyàn kọ̀ọ̀kan ní South Africa, tí ó jẹ́ pé àwọn maikiro-oganisimu tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ hànde ní wọ́n ṣe okùfà rẹ̀.
Zulu: Kulesi sahluko, ababhali badingide ngezifo zezilwane nezabantu eNingizimu Afrika ezibangelwa yilabo abangenwa ama-microorganisms.
Hausa: A wannan babi, marubutan sun tattauna game da wasu cututtukan dabbobi da na ɗan’sadam a Afirka ta Kudu waɗanda ƙananan halittu da aka gabatar suke haifar da su.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo kgaolong ye, bangwadi ba ahlaahlile malwetši a diphoofolo le a batho ka Afrika Borwa ao a bakwago ke diphedinyana tše di tlišitšwego.
Amharic: በዚህ ምእራፍ ውስጥ፣ ደራሲዎቹ በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ በተዋወቁት ረቂቅ ተሕዋስያን ምክንያት የሚከሰቱ አንዳንድ የእንስሳት እና የሰዎች በሽታዎችን ተወያይተዋል ።

English: They said the most dangerous was the ‘rinderpest’ disease, detected in South Africa in 1896.
Luganda: Baagamba nti obulwadde obusinga okuba obwakabi bwe bwa “nsotoka” obwajja mu South Afirika mu 1896.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé, èyí tí ó léwu jùlọ ni àrùn ‘àjàkálẹ̀ ọ̀sìn ẹran’ èyí tí wọ́n ṣe àwárí rẹ̀ ní South Africa ní ọdún 1896.
Zulu: Bathe esiyingozi kakhulu isifo ‘i-rinderpest’, esatholwa eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1896.
Hausa: Sun ce mafi haɗarin ita ce cutar ‘gudawar shanu’, wacce aka gano a Afirka ta Kudu a shekarar 1896.
Northern Sotho: Ba bolela gore bolwetši bjo kotsi kudu e be e le bolwetši bja ‘rinderpest’ , bjo bo utollotšwego ka Afrika Borwa ka 1896.
Amharic: በጣም አደገኛው በ1896 በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ የተገኘው በሽታ ‘የደስታ በሽታ’ በሽታ ነው አሉ።

English: Rinderpest was caused by a virus and affected cattle and buffaloes.
Luganda: Nsotoka yaleetebwa kawuka era n’akosa ente n’embogo.
Yoruba: Fáírọ́sì kan ni ó ṣe okùnfa àrun àjàkálẹ̀ ọ̀sìn ẹran, ó si ṣe ìpalára agbo màlúù àti Ẹfọ̀n.
Zulu: I-Rinderpest yabangelwa igciwane futhi yathinta izinkomo nezinyathi.
Hausa: Cutar Gudawar Shanu cuta ce da wata ƙwayar cuta take haifarwa kuma tana shanu da kuma ɓaunaye.
Northern Sotho: Rinderpest e bakilwe ke baerase gomme yona ya fetela dikgomo le dinare.
Amharic: የደስታ በሽታ በቫይረስ የተከሰተ ሲሆን ከብቶች እና ጎሾችን ጎድቷል።

English: The same virus caused measles in people.
Luganda: Akawuka ke kamu ako ke kaaleeta olukusense mu bantu.
Yoruba: Fáírọ́ọ̀sì yìí kan náà ṣe okùnfa ẹ̀yi ní ara àwọn ènìyàn.
Zulu: Igciwane elifanayo libangele isimungumungwane kubantu.
Hausa: Irin wannan ƙwayar cutar ta haifar da cutar ƙyanda a cikin mutane.
Northern Sotho: Baerase yona ye e bakile mooko go batho.
Amharic: ተመሳሳይ ቫይረስ በሰዎች ላይ ኩፍኝን አስከትሏል።

English: Many rural people faced hunger after the 1896 outbreak, but the disease has now been eradicated through vaccination.
Luganda: Abantu bangi mu byalo byaafuna enjala oluvannyuma lw’okubalukawo kw’obulwadde mu 1896, naye obulwadde obwo kati bumaliddwawo na kugema.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ àwọn tí wọ́n ń gbé ní abúle ni wọ́n kọjú ebi lẹ́yìn ìbújade ọdún 1896, ṣùgbọ́n àìsàn náà ti di píparun látàrí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára.
Zulu: Abantu abaningi basemaphandleni babhekane nendlala ngemva kokugqashuka kuka-1896, kodwa lesi sifo manje sesiqediwe ngokugoma.
Hausa: Yawancin mutanen karkara sun fuskanci yunwa bayan ɓarkewar shekarar 1896, amma yanzu an kawar da cutar ta hanyar rigakafi.
Northern Sotho: Batho ba bantši ba dinagamagaeng ba ile ba lebana le bohloki ka morago ga go phulega ga bolwetši bjo ka 1896, eupša mo lebakeng le bolwetši bjo bo fedišitšwe ka go šomiša meento.
Amharic: ከ1896 ወረርሽኝ በኋላ ብዙ የገጠር ሰዎች ረሃብ ገጥሟቸዋል፣ ነገር ግን በሽታውን አሁን በክትባት ማጥፋት ተችሏል።

English: The authors said between 1772 and 1861, many dogs in South Africa had rabies, even though people did not know what disease this was.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti wakati wa 1772 ne 1861, embwa nnyingi mu South Afirika zaalina obulwadde bw’embwa, wadde ng’abantu obulwadde obwo tebaabutegeera.
Yoruba: Àwọn oǹkọ̀wé sọ pé ní ọdún 1772 àti 1861, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ajá ní South Africa ní wọ́n ní àrun àrùn àramọ́ ara ajá -rébíìsì, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn ènìyàn kò mọ irúfẹ́ àrun tí ó jẹ́.
Zulu: Ababhali bathe phakathi kuka-1772 no-1861 izinja eziningi eNingizimu Afrika zinamarabi nakuba abantu bengazi ukuthi yisiphi isifo lesi.
Hausa: Marubutan sun ce tsakanin shekarar 1772 zuwa shekarar 1861, karnuka da yawa a Afirka ta Kudu suna fama da cutar hauka, duk da cewa mutane ba su san ko wace cuta ce wannan ba.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore magareng ga 1772 le 1861, dimpša tše ntši ka Afrika Borwa di be di na le bogaswi bja dimpša, le ge e le gore batho ba be ba sa tsebe gore bolwetši bjo e be e le eng.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ በ1772 እና 1861 መካከል፣ በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ብዙ ውሾች የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ እንደነበረባቸው ተናግረዋል፣ ምንም እንኳን ሰዎች ይህ በሽታ ምን እንደሆነ አያውቁትም ነበር።

English: By 1893, it was known that rabies was caused by a virus, so the government decided to kill affected dogs and vaccinate those not affected.
Luganda: 1893 we gwatuukira, kyali kitegeerekese nti obulwadde bw’embwa buleetebwa kawuka, awo nno gavumenti yasalawo okutta embwa ezaali zibufunye ate n’ezitaabulina ne zigemebwa.
Yoruba: Ní ìgbà tí ó di ọdún 1893, ó di mímọ̀ pé fáírọ́ọ̀sì ni ó ń ṣe okùnfa àrùn àramọ́ ara ajá -rébíìsì, fún ìdí èyí, àwọn ìjọba pinnu láti pa àwọn ajá tí wọhn kó àrun yìí, tí wọhn sì fún àwọn tí wọn kò kó o ní abẹ́ré àjẹsára.
Zulu: Ngo-1893, kwakwaziwa ukuthi amarabi ayebangelwa igciwane, ngakho uhulumeni wanquma ukubulala izinja ezithintekile futhi agome lezo ezingathintekile.
Hausa: A shekara ta 1893, an san cewa cutar hauka ce take haifar da cutar, don haka gwamnati ta yanke shawarar kashe karnukan da abin ya shafa tare da yi wa waɗanda abin bai shafa ba rigakafi.
Northern Sotho: Ka 1893, go be go tsebja gore bogaswi bja dimpša bo be bo bakwa ke baerase, ka fao mmušo o tšere sephetho sa go bolaya dimpša tše di fetetšwego le go entela tšeo di sego tša fetelwa.
Amharic: በ1893፣ የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ በቫይረስ መከሰቱ ይታወቃል፣ ስለዚህ መንግስት የተጎዱትን ውሾች ለመግደል እና ያልተጎዱትን ለመከተብ ወሰነ።

English: However, this did not eradicate the disease and it still affected many wild animals like duikers, lions, wild dogs, jackals and foxes.
Luganda: Wabula, kino tekyamalawo bulwadde obwo era ne bwongera okukosa ensolo endala ez’omu nsiko nga ensuku, empologoma, embwa ez’omu nsiko, ebbowa n’ebibe.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀, èyí kò pa àrùn náà rẹ̀, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ó ń tẹ̀síwájú láti máa yọ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ẹranko ìgbẹ́ bíi ẹtu, kìnìún, ajá ìgbẹ́, ajá igbó àti ìkokò lẹ́nu.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, lokhu akuzange kusiqede lesi sifo futhi sisathinta izilwane eziningi zasendle njengamaduike, amabhubesi, izinja zasendle, izimpungushe nezimpungushe.
Hausa: Duk da haka, wannan bai kawar da cutar ba kuma har yanzu tana shafar dabbobin daji da yawa kamar gwanki mai ruwan ƙasa da zakuna da karnukan daji da dila da kuma yanyawa.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, se ga se sa fediša bolwetši bjo gomme bo sa amile diphoofolo tša naga tše ntši tša go swana le ditshepe, ditau, mahlalerwa, diphukubje le diphoofolo tša bo phukubje.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ፣ ይህ በሽታውን አላጠፋም እና አሁንም እንደ ድኩላ፣ አንበሶች፣ የዱር ውሾች፣ ተኩላዎች እና ቀበሮዎች ያሉ ብዙ የዱር እንስሳትን ይጎዳል።

English: The authors said in 1928, 2 children were bitten by a Yellow Mongoose and died of rabies.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti mu 1928, abaana 2 baalumwa akatulume ne bafa obulwadde bw’embwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé sọ pé, ní ọdún 1928, ọmọdé 2 ni Yellow Mongoose bùjẹ, tí wọ́n sì kú ikú àrùn àramọ́ ara ajá -rébíìsì.
Zulu: Ababhali bathi ngo-1928, izingane ezi-2 zalunywa i-Yellow Mongoose zabulawa amarabi.
Hausa: Marubutan sun ce a cikin shekarar 1928, yara 2 ne wani Yellow Mongoose ya cije su kuma suka mutu a sakamakon kamuwa da cutar haukarsa.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore ka 1928, bana ba 2 ba ile ba longwa ke Tola ye Serolane gomme ba bolawa ke bolwetši bja dimpša.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ በ1928፣ 2 ልጆች በቢጫ ፍልፈል ተነከሱ እና በእብድ ውሻ በሽታ ሞቱ ብለዋል።

English: Since then, rabies became common in South Africa.
Luganda: Okuva olwo, obulwadde bw’embwa ne bubuna mu South Afirika.
Yoruba: Láti ìgbà náà, àrùn àramọ́ ara ajá -rébíìsì, di ohun tí ó wọ́pọ̀ ní South Africa.
Zulu: Kusukela lapho, isifo samarabi saba yinsakavukela eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Tun daga wannan lokacin ne, cutar haukar ta zama ruwan dare a Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga ka yona nako yeo, bolwetši bja dimpša bo ile bja thoma go tlwaelega ka Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: ከዚያን ጊዜ ጀምሮ፣ በደቡብ አፍሪካ የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ የተለመደ ሆነ።

English: They said in 1954, many South Africans were also affected by measles.
Luganda: Baagamba nti mu 1954, abantu bangi mu South Afirika baakosebwa olukusense.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ní ọdún 1954, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ọmọ orílẹ̀ èdè South Africa ní wọn kó àrùn ẹ̀yi.
Zulu: Bathe ngo-1954 baningi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlaselwa yisimungumungwane.
Hausa: Sun ce a shekarar 1954, da yawa daga cikin ‘yan Afirka ta Kudu ma sun kamu da cutar ƙyanda.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ka 1954, MaAfrika Borwa a mantši le bona ba ile ba fetelwa ke mooko.
Amharic: በ1954፣ ብዙ ደቡብ አፍሪካውያን በኩፍኝ ተጎድተዋል ብለዋል።

English: When this chapter was being written, measles was killing about 400 children each day.
Luganda: Essuula eno bwe yali ebagibwa, olukusense lwali lutta abaana nga 400 buli lunaku.
Yoruba: Ní ìgbà tí wọn kọ orí yìí, àrùn ẹ̀yí ń pa tó bíi ọmọ 400 ọmọdé ní ọjọ́ kan.
Zulu: Ngesikhathi kubhalwa lesi sahluko, isimungumungwane sasibulala izingane ezingaba ngu-400 usuku ngalunye.
Hausa: Lokacin da ake rubuta wannan babi, cutar ƙyanda tana kashe yara kusan 400 kowace rana.
Northern Sotho: Ge kgaolo ye e be e ngwalwa, mooko o be o bolaya bana bao ba ka bago ba 400 letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe.
Amharic: ይህ ምዕራፍ በሚጻፍበት ጊዜ፣ ኩፍኝ በየቀኑ ወደ 400 የሚጠጉ ሕፃናትን ይገድላል።

English: They said measles was common where people and cattle were in close contact.
Luganda: Baagamba nti olukusense lwali lwegiriisa nnyo mu bitundu abantu we baalinga balinaanye n’ensolo.
Yoruba: Wọhn ní àrùn ẹ̀yi wọ́pọ̀ ní ibi tí ènìyàn àti agbo màlúù bá ti súnmọ́ ara wọn.
Zulu: Bathe umkhuhlane wemvukuzane uvamile lapho abantu kanye lenkomo behlangana khona kakhulu.
Hausa: Sun ce cutar ƙyanda ta zama ruwan dare inda mutane da shanu suke mu’amala da juna.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore mooko o be o tlwaelegile fao batho le dikgomo ba bego ba le kgauswi le kgauswi.
Amharic: ሰዎች እና ከብቶች በቅርብ የሚገናኙበት ቦታ ኩፍኝ የተለመደ ነበር ብለዋል።

English: The authors also mentioned a disease called bovine tuberculosis (BTB), caused by bacteria.
Luganda: Abawandiisi era baayogera ku bulwadde obuyitibwa bovine tuberculosis (BTB), obuleetebwa bakitiiriya.
Yoruba: Àwọn oǹkọ̀wé tún mẹ́nubà pé bakitéríà ni ó ń ṣe okùnfà àrùn tí wọ́n ń pè ní ikọ́ ẹran (BTB).
Zulu: Ababhali baphinde bakhuluma ngesifo esibizwa nge-bovine tuberculosis (BTB), esibangelwa amagciwane.
Hausa: Marubutan sun kuma ambaci wata cuta mai suna tarin fuka na shanu ɗa ɓaunaye (BTB), wadda bakteriya take haifarwa.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gape gore bolwetši bjo bo bitšwago TB ya dikgomo (BTB), e bakile dipaktheria.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ በተጨማሪም የዳልጋ ከብት ሳንባ ነቀርሳ (ቢቲቢ) ተብሎ የሚጠራው፣ በባክቴሪያ የሚከሰት በሽታን ጠቅሰዋል።

English: BTB killed cattle, buffalo, warthogs, cheetahs, leopards, kudus, baboons and lions.
Luganda: BTB butta ente, embogo, warthog, cheetah, engo, kudus, amazike n’empologoma.
Yoruba: BTB ṣe ikú pa agbo màlúù, ẹfọ̀n, erinmi, àmọ̀tẹ́kùn, ẹ́kùn, ìnàkí, àti kìnìún.
Zulu: I-BTB yabulala izinkomo, izinyathi, ama-warthogs, izingulule, izingwe, ama-kudus, izimfene namabhubesi.
Hausa: BTB ta kashe shanu da ɓauna da aladen daji da damisa da gwanki da gwaggon biri da kuma zakuna.
Northern Sotho: BTB e bolaile dikgomo, dinare, dikolobesodi, mangau, dinkwe, ditholo, ditšhwene le ditau.
Amharic: ቢቲቢ ከብቶችን፣ ጎሾችን፣ ከርከሮዎችን፣ አቦሸማኔዎችን፣ ነብሮችን፣ አጋዘኖችን፣ ዝንጀሮዎችን እና አንበሶችን ገድሏል።

English: They said BTB disease was first reported in a South African national park in 1996.
Luganda: Baagamba nti BTB bwasooka kulabibwa mu kkuumiro ly’ebisolo mu South Afirika mu 1996.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé ọgba ìṣeré ńlá orílẹ̀ èdè South Africa ni ibi àkọ́kọ́ tí àrùn BTB ti léde ní ọdún 1996.
Zulu: Bathe isifo se-BTB sabikwa okokuqala esiqiwini saseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1996.
Hausa: Sun ce an fara samun ɓullar cutar BTB a wani wurin shakƙatawa na Afirka ta Kudu a cikin shekarar 1996.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore bolwetši bja BTB bo begilwe la mathomo ka serapeng sa diphoofolo sa bosetšhaba ka Afrika Borwa ka 1996.
Amharic: የቢቲቢ በሽታ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በደቡብ አፍሪካ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ ውስጥ በ1996 መከሰቱን ተናግረዋል ።

English: The government controlled the disease by killing the infected buffaloes.
Luganda: Gavumenti yafuga obulwadde obwo ng’egenda etta embogo ezaali zikoseddwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìjọba gba ìsàkóso àrùn yìí nípa pípa gbogbo àwọn ẹfọ̀n tí ó kó àrùn náà.
Zulu: Uhulumeni walawula lesi sifo ngokubulala izinyathi ezinegciwane.
Hausa: Gwamnati ta shawo kan cutar ta hanyar kashe ɓaunaye masu ɗauke da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Mmušo o laotše bolwetši bjo ka go bolaya dinare tšeo di bego di fetetšwe.
Amharic: መንግሥት በሽታውን የተቆጣጠረው የተበከሉትን ጎሾችን በመግደል ነው።

English: The authors said another virus, introduced into South Africa by travellers from Europe, caused a disease called ‘smallpox’ in people.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti akawuka akalala akaaleetebwa mu South Afirika abatambuze abava e Bulaaya, kaaleeta obulwadde obuyitibwa “kawaali” mu bantu.
Yoruba: Àwọn oǹkọ̀wé sọ pé irúfẹ́ fáírọ́sì mìíràn, wọ orílẹ̀ èdè South Africa láti ara àwọn arìnrìnàjò láti Yúróòpù, èyí tí ó sokùnfa àìsàn tí a mọ̀ sí ilẹ̀ gbóónà/olóde sí ara àwọn ènìyàn.
Zulu: Ababhali bathi elinye igciwane, elangeniswa eNingizimu Afrika ngabahambi abavela e-Europe, ladala isifo esibizwa nge‘smallpox’ kubantu.
Hausa: Marubutan sun ce wata ƙwayar cuta, wadda matafiya daga Turai suka ɓullo da ita a Afirka ta Kudu, ta haifar da wata cuta da ake kira cutar ‘agana’ a cikin mutane.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore baerase ye, ye e tlišitšwego ka Afrika Borwa ke baeti ba go tšwa Yorupa, e bakile bolwetši bjo bo biutšwago ‘sepšhatlapšhatlane’ go batho.
Amharic: ከአውሮፓ በተጓዦች ወደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ የገባው፣ ሌላ ቫይረስ፣ በሰዎች ላይ 'ፈንጣጣ' የሚባል በሽታን አምጥቷል ብለዋል ደራሲዎቹ።

English: The disease killed over 90% of the local Khoekhoe people.
Luganda: Obulwadde obwo bwatta AbaKhoekhoe abasukka mu 90% mu.
Yoruba: Àrùn yìí ṣe ikú pa ìdá 90% àwọn olùgbé Khoekhoe
Zulu: Lesi sifo sabulala abantu abangaphezu kuka-90% bendawo yamaKhoekhoe.
Hausa: Cutar ta kashe fiye da kashi 90% na mutanen Khoekhoe na gida.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bjo bo bolaile tekano ya go feta 90% ya batho ba MaKhoikhoi ba ka mo nageng.
Amharic: በሽታው ከ90% በላይ የሚሆኑትን የኬሆኬ ሰዎችን ገድሏል።

English: At the end of the disease outbreak, the Khoekhoe culture had been virtually destroyed.
Luganda: Obulwadde we bwaggweerawo, ng’obuwangwa bwa’AbaKhoekhoe kumpi busaanyeewo.
Yoruba: Ní òpin ìbújáde àrùn yìí, àwọn àṣà àwon ènìyàn Khoekhoe ti fẹ́rẹ̀ ẹ́ bàjẹ́ tán.
Zulu: Ekupheleni kokugqashuka kwesifo, isiko lamaKhoekhoe lase libhujisiwe.
Hausa: A ƙarshen ɓarkewar cutar, an kusan halaka al’adun Khoekhoe.
Northern Sotho: Mafelelong a go phulega ga bolwetši bjo, setšo sa MaKhoikhoi se be se sentšwe.
Amharic: የበሽታው መከሰት ወረርሽኝ ባበቃበት ወቅት፣ የኬሆኬ ባህል በእውነት ወድሟል።

English: The authors also reported on the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) that caused the AIDS disease outbreak.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baayogera ku Mukenenya (HIV) eyaleeta obulwadde bwa AIDS.
Yoruba: Àwọn Oǹkọ̀wé tún fi léde pé, lórí àwọn fáírọ́ọ̀sì ìsọdọ̀lẹ-àjẹsára ọmọ ènìyàn (HIV), tí ó ṣe okùnfa ìbújáde àrùn AIDS.
Zulu: Ababhali baphinde babika ngegciwane i-human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) elidale ukubheduka kwesifo sengculazi.
Hausa: Marubutan sun kuma bayar da rahoto game da ƙwayar cuta mai karya garkuwar jikin ɗan’adam (HIV) wacce ta haifar da ɓarkewar cutar AIDS.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba begile gape ka baerase ya go palediša mašole a mmele go šoma (HIV) yeo e bakilego go phulega ga bolwetši bja AIDS.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ደራሲዎቹ የኤድስ በሽታን ያስከተለውን የሰው በሽታ መከላከል አቅምን የሚያዳክም ቫይረስን (ኤችአይቪ) ዘግበዋል።

English: Scientists still think the virus was originally transferred to humans from animals, in a process called zoonosis.
Luganda: Bannassaayansi bakyalowooza nti akawuka ako kasooka kuleetebwa mu bantu nga kava mu nsolo, mu nkwajja eyitibwa zoonisis.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì ṣì lérò pé láti ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀pẹ̀, ara àwọn ẹranko ni fáírọ́sì yìí to ràn mọ́ ara àwọn ènìyàn, láti ara ìgbésẹ̀ tí wọ́n pè ní sunosís̀ (àrùn ìrànmọ́ ara ẹranko)
Zulu: Ososayensi basacabanga ukuthi leli gciwane ekuqaleni ladluliselwa kubantu lisuka ezilwaneni, ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-zoonosis.
Hausa: Masana kimiyya har yanzu suna tunanin asalin yaɗuwar ƙwayar cutar zuwa mutane daga dabbobi, a cikin wani tsari da ake kira nazari yaɗa cuta daga abin da ba ɗan’adam ba zuwa ɗan’adam.
Northern Sotho: Bašomi ba tša mahlale ba sa nagana gore baerase ye e thomile ka go fetetšwa go batho go tšwa diphoofolong, gomme ka yona nakong yeo ya bitšwa zoonosis.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶች አሁንም ቫይረሱ በመጀመሪያ ከእንስሳት ወደ ሰዎች የተላለፈ ነው ብለው ያስባሉ፣ ይህም ዞኖሲስ ተብሎ በሚጠራው ሂደት ነው።

English: The virus was first detected in South Africa in 1982.
Luganda: Akawuka ako kaasooka okulabibwa mu South Afirika mu 1982.
Yoruba: Orílẹ̀ èdè South Africa ni àrùn yìí ti kọ́kọ́ hànde ní ọdún 1982.
Zulu: Leli gciwane laqala ukutholakala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982.
Hausa: An fara gano cutar a Afirka ta Kudu a cikin shekarar 1982.
Northern Sotho: Baerase ye e utollotšwe la mathomo ka Afrika Borwa ka 1982.
Amharic: ቫይረሱ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በ1982 ደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ተገኝቷል።

English: They said, as of 2019, HIV had no vaccine or cure.
Luganda: Baagamba nti 2019 we gwatuukira, HIV yali talina ddagala ligema oba bujjanjabi bumuwonya.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní títí di ọdún 2019, HIV ọmọ ènìyàn yìí kò ì tíì ní abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára.
Zulu: Bathe, kusukela ngo-2019, i-HIV yayingenawo umuthi wokugoma noma ikhambi.
Hausa: Sun ce, ya zuwa shekarar 2019, HIV ba ta da alluran rigakafi ko magani.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore, go thoma ka 2019, HIV e be e se na moento goba phodišo.
Amharic: እስከ 2019 ድረስ፣ ኤችአይቪ ክትባትም ሆነ ፈውስ አልነበረውም፣ ብለዋል።

English: They concluded the chapter by talking about the West Nile Virus and African Swine Fever, which they said originated from Africa and spread to Europe and America.
Luganda: Essuula eyo baagikubira nga boogera ku West Nile Virus n’Omusujja gw’Embizzi, bwe baagamba nti bwava mu Afirika ne busaasaanira e Bulaaya ne Amerika.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fi orí yìí gúnlẹ̀ nípa sísọ̀rọ̀ nípa fáírọ́ìsì West Nile àti àrun ibá ẹlédẹ̀, èyí tí wọ́n sọ pé ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti Africa, tí ó sì ràn dé Europe àti America.
Zulu: Baphethe lesi sahluko ngokukhuluma ngegciwane iWest Nile Virus kanye ne-African Swine Fever abathi yaqhamuka e-Afrika yadlulela nase-Europe naseMelika.
Hausa: Sun ƙarƙare babin ne da magana kan cutar Nilu ta Yamma da kuma Zazzaɓin Alade na Afirka, wanda suka ce ya samo asali ne daga Afirka kuma ya yaɗu zuwa Turai da kuma Amurka.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba fetša kgaolo ka go bolela ka ga Baerase ya West Nile le Bolwetši bja Dikolobe bja Afrika ao ba boletšego gore a thomile ka Afrika gomme a phatlalela ka Yuropa le Amerika.
Amharic: የዌስት ናይል ቫይረስ እና የአፍሪካ የአሳማ ትኩሳት፣ ከአፍሪካ እንደመጣ እና ወደ አውሮፓ እና አሜሪካ መስፋፋቱን በማውሳት ምዕራፉን አጠቃለዋል።

English: The West Nile virus was transmitted by mosquitoes and killed mostly birds, but also affected horses and people.
Luganda: Akawuka ka-West Nile Virus kaasaasaanyizibwa nsiri era kaasinga kutta binyonyi, naye era kaakosa endogoyi n’abantu.
Yoruba: Láti ara ẹ̀fọn ní fáírọ́ìsì West Nile ti ràn tí ó ọ̀pọ̀ pa ẹyẹ, ṣùgbọ́n tí ó tún ran ẹṣin àti ènìyàn.
Zulu: Igciwane le-West Nile lalisakazwa omiyane futhi labulala izinyoni kakhulu, kodwa futhi lathinta amahhashi kanye nabantu.
Hausa: Sauro ne yake yaɗa Cutar Nilu ta Yamma kuma ta kashe galibin tsuntsaye, amma kuma tana shafar dawakai da kuma mutane.
Northern Sotho: Baerase ya West Nile e be e fetetšwa ke menang gomme yona ya bolaya dinonyana tše ntši, gomme le yona e amile dipere le batho.
Amharic: የዌስት ናይል ቫይረስ በወባ ትንኞች ይተላለፋል እና በአብዛኛው አእዋፍን ይገድላል፣ ነገር ግን ፈረሶችን እና ሰዎችንም ጭምር ይጎዳል።

English: They said animals like warthogs and bush pigs transmitted the African swine fever disease.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ensolo nga warthogs n’embizzi ez’omu nsiko zaasaasaanya omusujja gw’embizzi ogw’Ekifirika.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn ẹranko bíi Erinmi àti ẹlẹ́dẹ́ igbó ní wọ́n ṣe okùnfa àkóràn àrun ibá ẹlédẹ̀.
Zulu: Bathi izilwane ezinjengama-warthogs kanye nezingulube zasehlathini zisakaza isifo se-African swine fever.
Hausa: Sun ce dabbobi kamar aladun daji suna yaɗa cutar Zazzaɓin aladu na Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore diphoofolo tša go swana le dikolobesodi le dikolobe tša naga di feteditše bolwetši bja dikolobe bja Afrika.
Amharic: እንደ ከርከሮዎች እና የጫካ አሳማዎች ያሉ እንስሳት የአፍሪካን የአሳማ ትኩሳት በሽታ ያስተላልፋሉ ብለዋል።

English: The disease affected pigs, and greatly affected pig businesses.
Luganda: Obulwadde obwo bwakosa embizzi, era ne gukosa nnyo bizinensi y’embizzi.
Yoruba: Àrun yi ṣe ìpalára fún ẹlẹ́dẹ̀, tí ó sì mú ìpalára bá òwò ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ ṣíṣe.
Zulu: Lesi sifo sathinta izingulube, futhi saphazamisa kakhulu amabhizinisi ezingulube.
Hausa: Cutar ta shafi aladu, kuma ta shafi kasuwancin alade matuƙa.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bjo bo fetetše dikolobe, gomme se sa ama kudu dikgwebo tša dikolobe.
Amharic: በሽታው በአሳማዎችን ይጎዳል፣ እና የአሳማ ንግዶችን በእጅጉ ተጽዕኖ አሳድሯል።

English: The authors said they only discussed diseases caused by bacteria and viruses, so this chapter is not a complete account of all invasive microorganisms.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti baayogera ku ndwadde zokka eziva ku bakitiiriya n’obuwuka, noolwekyo essuula eno terombojja byonna ebikwata ku buwuka obusirikiti obusenguse.
Yoruba: Àwọn oǹkọ̀wé sọ pé àwọn kàn jíròrò lórí bakitéríà àti fáírọ́sì ni, fún ìdí èyí orí yìí kìí ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ tí ó kún fọ́fọ́ lórí gbogbo àjòjì maikiro-oganisimu.
Zulu: Ababhali bathi baxoxe ngezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane namagciwane kuphela, ngakho lesi sahluko asiyona i-akhawunti ephelele yawo wonke ama-microorganisms ahlaselayo.
Hausa: Marubutan sun ce sun tattauna ne kawai a kan cututtukan da bakteriya take da kuma ƙwayoyin cuta suke haifarwa, don haka wannan babi ba cikakken bayani ne na duk wasu ƙananan halittu masu mamaya ba.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore ba boletše fela ka ga malwetši ao a bakilego dipaktheria le dibaerase, ka fao kgaolo ye ga se kakaretšo ka botlalo ya diphedinyana ka moka tšeo di šwahlelago.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ እንደተናገሩት በባክቴሪያ እና በቫይረሶች የሚመጡ በሽታዎችን ብቻ ነው የተወያዩት፣ ስለዚህ ይህ ምዕራፍ ስለ ሁሉም ወራሪ ረቂቅ ተሕዋስያን የተሟላ ዘገባ አይደለም።

English: The authors were from South Africa.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baali bava mu South Afirika.
Yoruba: Láti orílẹ̀ èdè South Africa ni àwọn òǹkọ̀wé ti wá.
Zulu: Ababhali bebeqhamuka eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Marubutan sun fito ne daga Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba be ba etšwa Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ ከደቡብ አፍሪካ ነበሩ።
